title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 81
paragraphs: After this Cleomenes sent the greater part of his army back to Sparta, but he himself took a thousand of the best men and went to the temple of Hera to sacrifice. When he wanted to offer the sacrifice upon the altar, the priest forbade him, saying that it was not lawful by sacred custom for a foreigner to sacrifice there. Cleomenes, however, ordered the Helots to drag the priest away from the altar and scourge him, and he himself performed the sacrifice. After that he returned to Sparta.
